commentaire: The stage 6 of the Österreich-Rundfahrt ended with a field sprint, while the chasing peloton was deviated into a wrong route with 25 kilometers left. The UCI considered not to give any points for the stage and keep the GC of the previous day. Therefore, no CQ-points are awarded.
titre: Österreich-Rundfahrt / Tour of Austria, Stage 6 : Lienz - St. Michael/Lungau (154 km)
